title: TCF corner
subtitle: A2 · Unit 7: Health appointments and getting help

steps.title: Exam style
steps.body: These questions look like the real TCF Canada: one play, four options, one answer. A wrong and a blank answer both score zero, so always choose.

steps.fr: Le rendez-vous en personne est jeudi à 10 h. L'adresse se trouve dans le message que le service a envoyé.
steps.question: Where is the address?
options: In the message sent by the service
steps.explain: The recording says the address is in the service's message.

steps.fr: Le service va appeler la personne qui demande un suivi. L'appel va arriver avant midi.
steps.question: When will the person receive a call?
steps.explain: The recording says the call will come before noon.

steps.fr: Le formulaire demande le début de la gêne et l'heure où elle commence.
steps.question: What two details does the form ask for?
options: Start time and when it begins
steps.explain: The speaker names the beginning and the time it starts; no medication information is requested.

steps.prompt: What document should the patient bring?
steps.explain: The notice asks for the lab result.
steps.promptFr: CONSULTATION — Lundi, 15 h. Document à apporter : le résultat de laboratoire. Adresse dans le message de confirmation.

steps.prompt: By when should the caller expect the call?
steps.explain: The notice says the call is before sixteen hundred hours.
steps.promptFr: RAPPEL — Une personne du service va appeler la personne qui a téléphoné. L'appel est avant 16 h.

steps.prompt: What should the patient do on the form?
options: Give the symptom, start time and duration
steps.explain: The form asks for the symptom, start time and duration; the professional reads it at the consultation.
steps.promptFr: FORMULAIRE — Symptôme, heure de début et durée. Le professionnel lit le formulaire pendant la consultation.
